data.one_liner: Render text tables for CLI-based Dart applications with custom borders, padding, and ANSI colors.
data.what_it_does: Barbecue allows you to create and render text tables for command-line applications in Dart. It supports features like borders, padding, cell styling, text alignment, row and column spans, and ANSI colors.
use_when: You are building a command-line application in Dart and need to display tabular data.
You need styled output with custom borders, padding, and ANSI colors in your terminal.
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter GUI application rather than a command-line tool.
Your output relies heavily on unpredictable full-width or fractional-width unicode characters.
strengths: Supports row and column spans, padding, and text alignment.
Customizable borders and ANSI color support.
Experimental support for emoji and wide characters.
weaknesses: Relies on monospaced font assumptions which can break depending on the user's terminal font.
Limited support for emojis and other wide characters.

alternatives.name: console
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a robust set of tools and features for console and CLI applications in Dart.
